input: Freeze a month's worth of baby food portions

gold.taskTitle: Freeze a month of baby food portions
gold.taskDescription: Prepare, portion, and freeze a full month's supply of baby food for convenient daily use.

questions.title: How old is your baby right now?
questions.description: Age determines texture, stage, and appropriate ingredients for the baby food.

questions.title: Which specific foods or flavors do you plan to make?
questions.description: Knowing the intended foods helps plan prep steps, cooking methods, and quantities.

questions.title: What is the target portion size per serving?
questions.description: Portion size in ounces or tablespoons affects how many containers or cubes are needed.

questions.title: How many meals or servings does your baby eat per day?
questions.description: Daily serving count determines the total number of portions to prepare for a full month.

questions.title: Do you already have freezer storage containers or trays?
questions.description: Knowing available equipment helps determine whether supplies need to be purchased first.

questions.title: Will you cook everything in one session or multiple?
questions.description: The preferred prep approach shapes how the task is broken into manageable steps and days.

questions.title: Are there any allergies or ingredients to avoid entirely?
questions.description: Dietary restrictions must be identified upfront to ensure every recipe is safe for the baby.
